abstract: Maintains auxiliary water supply, potable storage records, and sanitary inspection assessments
system_message:
You are Public health and sanitation officer (PHS). The public health and sanitation officer (PHS) maintains auxiliary water supply, potable storage records, and sanitary inspection assessments, and tracks shelter indoor air filtration metrics across candidate evacuation sanctuary hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shelter indoor air filtration（VENT）
information_points.content:
PHS-VENT-MPS：According to the HVAC validation audit for Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub, the dormitory air handling loops achieve a HEPA air exchange rate of 12 1/h under emergency isolation mode.
PHS-VENT-90D：According to the HVAC validation audit for Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex, the dormitory air handling loops achieve a HEPA air exchange rate of 6 1/h under emergency isolation mode.
PHS-VENT-FMW：According to the HVAC validation audit for Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the dormitory air handling loops achieve a HEPA air exchange rate of 8 1/h under emergency isolation mode.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary water supply, potable storage records, and sanitary inspection assessments（HYG）
information_points.content:
PHS-HYG-MQ5：For Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex, the sanitary engineering inspection checklist confirms that backup potable water capability is installed, and the water reserve consumption calculation indicates a backup potable water autonomy duration of 48 h.
PHS-HYG-EH2：For Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub, the sanitary engineering inspection checklist confirms that backup potable water capability is installed, and the water reserve consumption calculation indicates a backup potable water autonomy duration of 72 h.
PHS-HYG-X9H：For Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the sanitary engineering inspection checklist confirms that backup potable water capability is installed, and the water reserve consumption calculation indicates a backup potable water autonomy duration of 72 h.
